description: California licensed contractors from the CSLB (Contractors State License Board) public Data Portal for one license classification (e.g. B, C-10 Electrical, C-36 Plumbing), optionally one county: license number, business name and type, address, phone, county, issue/expiration dates, classifications and status; county lists add bond and workers' comp insurer. Filter by city; paged. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

classification.description: CSLB classification code, e.g. A, B, C-10, C-36, C-61/D-12

county.description: California county name, e.g. Los Angeles (recommended for big classes like B or C-10)

name: b2b_cslb_california
title: B2b Cslb California
